create.name: Grace Bryant
create.bio:
Grace Bryant is a meditation and Tantra teacher and spiritual mentor in Washington State, who uses they/them pronouns. Their own way in was unpromising: a sceptical first yoga class at a gym in Seattle, years of restaurant shifts, then a slow return to practice in Boston that grew into study of the Yoga Sutras, Buddhist mindfulness, Ayurveda and Tantric yoga. They have taught yoga and meditation since 2007 and now teach in the line of Hridaya Yoga, a non-dual Tantric path centred on meditation on the spiritual heart.

Grace founded Tantra Immersion School, which started in Seattle in 2018 and has run online since 2020, offering short modules on themes such as yoga nidra and self-compassion, a low-cost introductory workshop, small mentoring groups, a free monthly sangha and a year-long cohort. With Dianna Heston they also co-founded Hridaya Northwest, which has held silent meditation retreats near Hood Canal since 2017. Their one-to-one spiritual mentorship runs online or by phone on a sliding scale. Their teaching often ties inner practice to intimacy, community and questions of race and oppression, and they post guided meditations, Tonglen practices and short talks on YouTube and Insight Timer.

courses.title: Spiritual Mentorship with Grace Bryant
courses.description: One-to-one sessions online or by phone for people who want steady support with their spiritual practice, drawing on meditation, breath, yoga, voice and creative work as fits the person. Fees are on a sliding scale and a free 20-minute call comes first.

courses.title: Tantra Immersion Yearlong Cohort
courses.description: Tantra Immersion School's longest course: weekly live online classes in classical non-dual Tantra in the Hridaya style, morning or evening, with a silent group retreat that can be joined online or in person in Union, Washington.

courses.title: Yoga Nidra Module: 4 Weeks of Deep Rest
courses.description: Four live online Thursday classes in yoga nidra, the guided practice of resting awareness between waking and sleep. Open to newcomers, with a morning and an evening group.

courses.title: Intro to Tantra Workshop
courses.description: A three-hour live online workshop, held about once a quarter, that explains what classical Tantra is and is not and tries out some of its practices. A low-cost starting point before the longer modules.

courses.title: Tantra Immersion: Self-Compassion Module
courses.description: Eight weekly online classes on turning compassion inward, using Tantric and Buddhist practices such as Tonglen. Open to all, with a sliding-scale fee; registration opens in January 2027.

courses.title: Small Group Tantra Mentorship
courses.description: A four-week mentoring group for students who want closer guidance with their Tantric practice alongside a few peers. Places are by application and the fee is chosen within a range.

courses.title: 5-Day New Year's Silent Meditation Retreat
courses.description: Hridaya Northwest's residential silent retreat over New Year at a retreat centre on Hood Canal in Union, Washington, for beginners and seasoned meditators. Days run from early morning sitting to an evening session, with vegetarian meals and a long afternoon break.
courses.price: $895–$1,695 USD depending on room and booking date

courses.title: 4-Day Spring Silent Meditation Retreat
courses.description: A shorter residential silent retreat with Hridaya Northwest in Union, Washington, built around Hridaya heart meditation, gentle movement and teachings, with daily written questions answered by the leaders.
courses.price: $895–$1,695 USD depending on room and booking date

free_resources.title: Grace Bryant on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Grace's guided meditations and practices, free to play in the Insight Timer app or on the web.

free_resources.title: Meditations & Practices
free_resources.description: A free library on Grace's site of short guided videos: breathing practices, body scans, mantra and Tonglen meditations, Hridaya silent heart sittings and gentle warm-up movements.

free_resources.title: Monthly Tantra Sangha
free_resources.description: A free gathering on Zoom on the first Saturday of each month, with a short teaching, shared practice and time to connect. Open to anyone interested in Tantra.

flags: Base: their home page says they live and work in Jefferson County, Washington State; the town is not printed in visible text. Port Townsend is used because their in-person workshops are held there (bewholebehappy.com/workshops, /mindful-mamas-port-townsend) and it is Jefferson County's only city; the business address in the site's structured data is also Port Townsend. Please confirm.
Regional: Port Townsend, Washington (Olympic Peninsula), far from the big coastal cities.
Grace uses they/them pronouns (Tantra Immersion and Hridaya Northwest team pages); the bio follows that.

Resident-teacher rule applied: Grace is founder of Tantra Immersion School and co-founder of Hridaya Northwest (team pages tantraimmersion.com/about-us and hridayanorthwest.com/about-us), so each of their own current programmes there counts. Neither is a Spiritpedia hub, so no teaches_at link.
Email grace@bewholebehappy.com appears only in the site's hidden structured data, not as published text, so the contact form is used.

Health rule, borderline: the Mindful Intimacy Coaching page lists replacing anxiety and releasing trauma stored in the body among its aims, the Holistic Life Coaching page calls Grace a 'personal health care coach', and the Vocal Coaching page is framed as trauma-aware nervous-system work; all three left out. The articles page has an 'Anxiety Support' category and one YouTube talk is titled 'A Cure for Anxiety'; these are a small part of a mostly meditation and Tantra channel, so the listing was kept. Owner may wish to review.
The Tantra Immersion yearlong cohort is a team course (Grace with Jess Epps, Michelle Raine and others); retreats are co-led with Dianna Heston.
YouTube channel avatar is the Be Whole Be Happy logo, so not used; both photos are from Grace's own site (photographer credit Lara Randalls on the headshot).
The site footer links an affiliate code for Beducated; not used.
left_out: Mindful Intimacy Coaching, Holistic Life Coaching and Vocal Coaching: condition and trauma framing on their pages (health rule).

Mindful Intimacy and Sex & Race collections, and the Sex + Race parenting course: not spiritual teaching or no price found.
YouTube: 'A Cure for Anxiety: Coping vs Letting Go' (condition in title), interviews on sex education and racism, and a retreat share video left out.
